params.body:
A read tool for the trial of the own cut-out service (#1004, built in #1006): the workbench cannot reach the bucket, and the existing reads are aggregates by mandate, so a trial on real photos had no way in. `photos_sample` gives it one, under its own kind of mandate.

## What it answers

`GET /api/control/tools/photos_sample?args={count, window, label, seed}`: a random sample of vehicle photos, per photo

- `original`, `cutout` and `background`: signed addresses of the upload, of the cut-out remove.bg made of it, and of the dealer's background, valid two hours;
- `label`: `cut` when the cut-out differs from the original, `kept` when the original stands in for it (remove.bg refused: an interior, a detail, R S1-6.8), read off the file sizes; `unknown` when the bucket did not answer;
- `bytes` and `platform_copy`.

`count` is 1 to 200 (default 50), `label` filters on the label, the same `seed` gives the same sample. No garage name, no dealer or vehicle id as a field, no person. The addresses carry the file path, as the partner API's do, and the plates stay on the originals: that is what the trial needs, and the mandate's text says so.

## Its own kind

The sample is not an aggregate, so it does not sit under `stocklist.read`. Each read tool now names its kind (`Reads::kindOf`, in the menu as `kind`), and `ReadMandate::verify` checks the tool's kind: a mandate for the figures answers 403 on the sample and the other way round. Portal's 30-day read word for the Stocklist project names `stocklist.photos_read` in a separate pull request; a word issued before that does not open the sample until the owner admits reading again.

Rule R P3-17.8; R P3-17.6 points at it; `docs/api/control-reads.md` documents the tool. Tests in `ControlReadTest`: the kind check both ways, the addresses and labels, the seed, the label filter, the absent fields, and the 422s for a wrong label or count.

Full suite green (3083 tests).
params.title: photos_sample: a read of vehicle photos for the cut-out trial, under its own mandate kind
